taxonomy_note: Workflow routing only. Choose final root-cause taxonomy from supported evidence.

controls.boundary: Booking cancellation eligibility and refund/credit conservation
controls.source_trace: Trace the cancellation actor, effective time and booking version into both inventory release and financial consequence.
controls.implementation_branch: Record whose clock/timezone controls the deadline and whether the booking version includes rescheduling or partial fulfillment. A late request may be permitted by explicit grace or operator override. Verify financial credit and inventory release independently rather than reading only a cancellation status.
controls.operational_method: Write the cancellation matrix for unused, partially fulfilled, rescheduled and expired bookings using the actual grace/penalty policy. Bind the approved booking version and authoritative timezone/deadline to the refund and inventory release. Repeat the same synthetic cancellation delivery and verify both credit and released inventory stay within that matrix; one successful status without either committed effect is insufficient.
controls.controlled_verification: Use owned sandbox bookings; compare valid cancellation with a late or foreign cancellation and inspect credit plus booking state.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: A canceled UI label without credit or resource effect is insufficient; honor actual grace and timezone policy.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Make cancellation and associated credit/release transitions consistent and verify deadlines, retries and partial failures.
